states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.culture: Tradition-led buyers; silk sarees and gold central to festivals; Aadi discount month is a unique sale season; strong value-seeking in tier-2 towns.
states.ecommerce: Amazon Bazaar TN orders up 5x YoY (May 2026), Chennai new sign-ups 2x; 1,700+ TN sellers. Shiprocket: COD 40%, AOV ~Rs1,163, top products perfumes, plated jewellery, books.

festivals.name: Pongal (Bhogi to Kaanum Pongal)
festivals.significance: Tamil harvest festival; Thai month begins; biggest TN festival
festivals.buys: new clothes, sarees, veshti, pongal pots, sugarcane, jaggery, kolam colours, gifts, appliances
festivals.impact_reason: Peak apparel and home purchase window; platforms run Pongal sales in TN; 4-day state holiday

festivals.name: Jallikattu season
festivals.significance: Bull-taming events around Pongal in Madurai region
festivals.impact_reason: Mostly offline rural spectacle; little direct online demand

festivals.name: Thaipusam
festivals.significance: Murugan festival; Palani pilgrimage, kavadi
festivals.buys: yellow/saffron dhotis, puja items, kavadi accessories, travel
festivals.impact_reason: Devotional and travel-led; modest online puja-item demand

festivals.name: Ramzan / Eid al-Fitr
festivals.significance: End of Ramadan; large Muslim communities in Chennai, coastal TN
festivals.buys: new clothes, attar, dates, dry fruits, sweets, gifts, footwear
festivals.impact_reason: Fashion/attar demand; perfumes are top online product in TN per Shiprocket

festivals.name: Tamil New Year
festivals.significance: Chithirai 1; Tamil new year with family feast and new purchases
festivals.buys: new clothes, gold, fruits, puja items, appliances, panchangam
festivals.impact_reason: Auspicious purchase day; summer sales for AC/fridge overlap; jewellers and e-tailers push offers

festivals.name: Chithirai Thiruvizha (Madurai)
festivals.significance: Month-long Madurai temple festival; celestial wedding and Kallazhagar Vaigai entry
festivals.buys: silk sarees, gold, puja items, travel
festivals.impact_reason: Regional spike in Madurai; mostly offline but drives saree/jewellery searches

festivals.name: Akshaya Tritiya
festivals.significance: Auspicious day for gold purchase
festivals.impact_reason: TN is a top gold market; jewellers run online booking and digital gold offers

festivals.name: Bakrid
festivals.significance: Eid al-Adha; feasts and charity
festivals.buys: new clothes, meat, spices, kitchenware, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Apparel and grocery uplift among Muslim households

festivals.name: School reopening
festivals.significance: New academic year after summer break
festivals.buys: school bags, uniforms, notebooks, shoes, lunch boxes, laptops
festivals.impact_reason: Educational books are a top online product in TN (Shiprocket); back-to-school demand

festivals.name: Aadi month sale
festivals.significance: Inauspicious Tamil month; retailers run deep discount sales
festivals.buys: sarees, textiles, jewellery, footwear, appliances, furniture
festivals.impact_reason: TN's signature discount season; Flipkart ran 'Aadi Thallaadhabadi' sale in July 2026

festivals.name: Aadi Perukku
festivals.significance: Aadi 18; river/water festival, women pray for prosperity
festivals.buys: puja items, bangles, new clothes, gold
festivals.impact_reason: Ritual festival; mostly offline puja purchases

festivals.name: Varalakshmi Vratham
festivals.significance: Women's puja to goddess Lakshmi for family prosperity
festivals.buys: silk sarees, gold jewellery, kalasam, puja items, flowers
festivals.impact_reason: Jewellery brands (CaratLane, GIVA) run targeted campaigns

festivals.name: Velankanni Festival
festivals.significance: 11-day feast at Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, Nagapattinam
festivals.impact_reason: Pilgrim travel; minimal online retail

festivals.name: Krishna Jayanthi
festivals.significance: Birth of Krishna; kolam footprints, sweets
festivals.buys: kids' Krishna costumes, sweets, puja items, flute toys
festivals.impact_reason: Kids costume and puja online demand

festivals.name: Vinayagar Chathurthi
festivals.significance: Ganesha festival; clay idols at home
festivals.buys: clay idols, puja kits, kozhukattai ingredients, decor, flowers
festivals.impact_reason: Kickstarts festive quarter; puja kits and decor sold online

festivals.name: Navaratri Golu
festivals.significance: Nine nights; homes display tiered doll steps (golu)
festivals.buys: golu dolls, steps, silk sarees, return gifts, sundal ingredients
festivals.impact_reason: Overlaps Big Billion Days / Great Indian Festival sales; golu dolls and return gifts sold online

festivals.name: Ayudha Pooja and Vijayadasami
festivals.significance: Worship of tools, vehicles, books; Vijayadasami for new beginnings
festivals.buys: vehicles, tools, appliances, stationery, puja items, banana leaves
festivals.impact_reason: Auspicious for vehicle and appliance purchases; peak national sale period

festivals.name: Deepavali
festivals.significance: Biggest shopping festival; early-morning oil bath, new clothes, crackers
festivals.buys: new clothes, sweets, crackers, gold, phones, TVs, appliances, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Peak e-commerce season nationally; TN Amazon orders up 5x YoY (Amazon Bazaar, 2026)

festivals.name: Karthigai Deepam
festivals.significance: Festival of lamps; Tiruvannamalai Maha Deepam
festivals.buys: agal lamps, ghee, oil, decor lights, sweets
festivals.impact_reason: Lamps and decor bought online; regional TN-specific

festivals.name: Sabarimala season (TN devotees)
festivals.significance: 41-day Ayyappa vow; many TN men wear black/blue dhotis
festivals.buys: black dhotis, malas, irumudi kits, travel bags
festivals.impact_reason: Large TN devotee base; dhoti and puja kit demand

festivals.name: Christmas
festivals.significance: Significant Christian population in south TN and Chennai
festivals.buys: stars, cribs, cakes, gifts, new clothes, decor
festivals.impact_reason: Year-end sale season; decor and gifting

festivals.name: Margazhi music and dance season
festivals.significance: Chennai December season; kolam and devotional month
festivals.buys: silk sarees, kolam powder, concert tickets
festivals.impact_reason: Niche, Chennai-centric

states.name: Kerala
states.culture: High-literacy, remittance-rich, gold-loving market; Onam and Vishu dominate; strong Muslim (Malabar) and Christian festival calendars.
states.ecommerce: Onam spend est. Rs10-20K cr, retail +30-40% (Manorama); higher online-shopper share than India avg. Shiprocket: COD 42%, AOV ~Rs1,024, Sep peak; perfumes, shorts, plated jewellery.

festivals.name: Vishu
festivals.significance: Malayalam astronomical new year; Vishukkani and kaineettam
festivals.buys: konna flowers, Vishukkani items, new clothes (Vishu kodi), crackers, sadya groceries, gold
festivals.impact_reason: Second-biggest Kerala shopping festival; summer AC/fridge season overlap

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.significance: Biggest Kerala festival; King Mahabali's homecoming, 10 days from Atham
festivals.buys: kasavu sarees/mundu, onakkodi clothes, gold, TVs, appliances, phones, pookalam flowers, sadya groceries
festivals.impact_reason: Onam spend est. Rs10-20K cr; retail up 30-40%; Amazon runs Onam store; Kerala's annual peak

festivals.name: Chingam 1 and wedding season
festivals.significance: Start of Malayalam year; Chingam is peak wedding/house-warming month
festivals.buys: wedding gold, silk sarees, furniture, appliances
festivals.impact_reason: Gold and wedding purchases cluster in Chingam alongside Onam

festivals.name: Karkidakam month
festivals.significance: Monsoon month for Ayurvedic rejuvenation and Ramayana reading; Karkidaka Vavu
festivals.buys: Ayurvedic kits (karkidaka kanji), oils, rainwear, umbrellas
festivals.impact_reason: Ayurveda health kits sold online; Ayurvedic products trending in Shiprocket island/south data

festivals.name: Karkidaka Vavu
festivals.significance: Ancestral rites day
festivals.impact_reason: Ritual, offline

festivals.name: Attukal Pongala
festivals.significance: Massive women's offering at Attukal temple, Thiruvananthapuram
festivals.buys: clay pots, rice, jaggery, firewood, sarees
festivals.impact_reason: Local Thiruvananthapuram event; mostly offline

festivals.name: Thrissur Pooram
festivals.significance: Grand temple festival at Vadakkunnathan; elephants and fireworks
festivals.impact_reason: Tourism/local spend; little online impact

festivals.name: Eid al-Fitr
festivals.significance: End of Ramadan; ~26% Muslim population, esp. Malabar
festivals.buys: new clothes, attar, mehendi, footwear, dates, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Large Malabar fashion demand; perfumes are top online product in Kerala (Shiprocket)

festivals.name: Bakrid
festivals.significance: Eid al-Adha; feasts
festivals.impact_reason: Apparel and grocery uplift in Malabar

festivals.name: Milad-un-Nabi
festivals.significance: Prophet's birthday; processions in Malabar
festivals.impact_reason: Modest; 2026 overlaps Onam

festivals.name: Easter
festivals.significance: Christian festival (~18% Christian pop.), end of Lent
festivals.impact_reason: Christian households in central Kerala; apparel and food

festivals.name: Christmas and New Year
festivals.significance: Major in Kerala; stars, cribs, plum cakes; Kochi Carnival at year end
festivals.buys: stars, cribs, LED lights, plum cakes, wine, gifts, new clothes
festivals.impact_reason: Strong Christian population plus year-end sales; decor and gifting online

festivals.name: School reopening (Praveshanolsavam)
festivals.significance: Schools reopen with monsoon onset
festivals.buys: bags, umbrellas, raincoats, uniforms, notebooks, footwear
festivals.impact_reason: Combined back-to-school and monsoon demand

festivals.name: Krishna Jayanthi
festivals.significance: Krishna birth; Balagokulam Shobha Yatra processions
festivals.impact_reason: Costume demand for children

festivals.name: Navaratri and Vidyarambham
festivals.significance: Ayudha puja, book puja; Vidyarambham initiates children into learning
festivals.buys: books, stationery, slates, vehicles, puja items
festivals.impact_reason: Overlaps national festive sales; stationery and vehicles

festivals.name: Deepavali
festivals.significance: Observed but smaller in Kerala than other states
festivals.impact_reason: Smaller culturally, but national festive sales drive Kerala online orders

festivals.name: Sabarimala Mandala-Makaravilakku
festivals.significance: Ayyappa pilgrimage season; 41-day vratham
festivals.buys: black/blue mundu, malas, irumudi kits, travel
festivals.impact_reason: Huge pilgrim footfall; devotional wear and puja kits

festivals.name: Akshaya Tritiya
festivals.significance: Auspicious day for buying gold
festivals.impact_reason: Kerala is a major gold market; jewellers push online booking

festivals.name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race
festivals.significance: Snake boat race on Punnamada Lake, Alappuzha (2nd Sat of Aug)
festivals.impact_reason: Tourism event; minimal e-commerce

festivals.name: Maramon Convention
festivals.significance: Large Christian gathering on Pamba riverbed
festivals.impact_reason: Offline gathering

states.name: Lakshadweep
states.culture: ~96% Muslim island population (~65k, Census 2011); Eid is the main shopping occasion; scarce local retail, reliance on mainland goods.
states.ecommerce: Amazon delivers to Agatti since 2017 via delivery partner; exploring Kavaratti/Andrott; weather and unstable internet limit e-commerce.

festivals.name: Ramadan month
festivals.significance: Holy month of fasting for ~96% Muslim population
festivals.buys: dates, groceries, prayer items, attar, clothes for Eid
festivals.impact_reason: Pre-Eid ordering window given long shipping times from mainland

festivals.name: Eid al-Fitr
festivals.significance: Most widely celebrated festival in Lakshadweep
festivals.buys: new clothes, attar, sweets, gifts, footwear
festivals.impact_reason: Peak apparel demand; limited delivery (Amazon serves Agatti since 2017)

festivals.name: Bakrid
festivals.significance: Eid al-Adha with congregational prayer and Qurbani
festivals.impact_reason: Second Eid; apparel orders

festivals.name: Muharram
festivals.significance: Islamic new year/mourning observances
festivals.impact_reason: Observance; little shopping

festivals.name: Milad-un-Nabi
festivals.significance: Prophet's birthday; prayers, Quran recitation, processions
festivals.impact_reason: Moderate local spend

festivals.name: Independence Day
festivals.significance: Among most celebrated events per UT administration
festivals.buys: flags, uniforms, phones on national sales
festivals.impact_reason: National sales, but sea/air logistics limit online reach

festivals.name: Republic Day
festivals.significance: Widely celebrated per UT administration
festivals.impact_reason: National sales; logistics constraints

festivals.significance: Cultural event on Minicoy (Mahl-speaking) with Lava dance
festivals.impact_reason: Local cultural event; date unverified

festivals.local_name: Great Indian Festival / Big Billion Days
festivals.significance: Not a local festival, but pan-India sale season reaches islanders
festivals.impact_reason: Islanders shop national sales, but delivery limited to some islands
